title: drymocallis glandulosa var. reflexa
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa var. reflexa, commonly known as Western sweetroot, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Western sweetroot include soothing digestive issues, relieving pain, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
